title: m5stack/m5stack-linux-dtoverlays #20 round 2: ff4cd84 fixes the DEBOUNCE drop path, restores READY after a flip-back and restarts at .shutdown; host-level matrix passes, two non-blocking residuals

execution.environment: macOS arm64; no Cardputer Zero hardware; Device Service cardputer-zero profile supported=false creatable=false backend_ready=false (__missing_qemu__/__missing_rom__); no Linux kernel headers; docker daemon still unusable (read-only containerd state dir)

checks.name: probe_defaults
checks.evidence: T1: no m5stack,power-hold-ms -> hold_ms 20000, 0xB2/0xB3 = 20000; prefixed property read, legacy unprefixed property ignored (T14)

checks.name: debounce_recheck
checks.evidence: T6: with a 700 ms debounce, 0xB6 reads 2 at the 1500/1600/1700 checks; the check re-arms every 100 ms and only calls orderly_poweroff once 0xB6 reads 3 (at 1800); no decision while the state is 2

checks.name: irq_not_rearmed_while_low
checks.evidence: T6/T7/T24: enable_irq count is 0 for the whole low period; it becomes 1 only after the line reads high; a later switch-off still fires the IRQ

checks.name: flipback_during_countdown
checks.evidence: T7 (requested scenario): line high at 1300 while the chip is counting down -> no orderly_poweroff, no backstop, IRQ re-armed; ready work sees 0xB6=3 and polls, then writes 0xB0=1 once at 21500 when 0xB6 reads 1; no write before that

checks.name: shutdown_restart_when_slider_on
checks.evidence: T8 (requested scenario): slider_off latched then line high -> powerfail_suo_shutdown() calls emergency_restart(), cancels the backstop, does NOT program 200 ms and does NOT assert disabled-gpios

checks.name: shutdown_other_paths
checks.evidence: T9 slider low after a slider-off -> 200 ms + disabled-gpios; T10 menu poweroff -> 200 ms, no restart, LCD reset untouched; T11 reboot -> OFF_TIME untouched; T23 no power controller -> chip untouched

checks.name: backstop_min_hold
checks.evidence: T12: hold_ms 12000 -> backstop due 9000 for a 1000 flip, i.e. 8 s after the flip and 4 s before the real cut; T6: backstop due 17700 vs real cut 21750 (4.05 s margin)

checks.name: hold_clamp
checks.evidence: T13: 4000 and 8000 clamp to 12000, 70000 clamps to 60000

checks.name: fallback_removed
checks.evidence: T3: disabled-gpios pointing at the M5IOE1 without m5stack,power-controller leaves data->ioe NULL and the stock 2000 ms hold; T16/T17 OFF_TIME failure still takes the SysRq U + LCD reset path

checks.name: state_semantics_reading
checks.evidence: T20 spurious edge with the slider on -> no poweroff, READY untouched; T21 flick back inside the debounce -> no poweroff, READY never cleared; T22 0xB6 read error -> orderly_poweroff

checks.name: remove_refcount
checks.evidence: T18: remove restores 2000 when slider_off is clear and leaves the hold alone after a slider-off; the devm action still owns the i2c client reference on the probe-failure paths (devm_add_action_or_reset with data->ioe=NULL afterwards)

checks.name: hung_poweroff_flipback_gap
checks.evidence: T25/T26: slider_off latched, orderly_poweroff at 1500, userspace never reaches .shutdown, line high at 8000 or at 18000 -> emergency_restart() is never called: the backstop only runs SysRq S+U once, the chip returns to state 1 with SW_EN holding the boost, and READY is not restored; the board stays in a half-shutdown with read-only filesystems. A backstop-side line check covers flips before hold-4 s (T25, proposed patch) but a flip after that (T26) still has no path; a periodic poll armed in powerfail_orderly() until the cut would close the whole window. Non-blocking

checks.name: gpio_error_unbounded
checks.evidence: T19: gpiod_get_raw_value_cansleep() error -> powerfail_recheck() every 100 ms forever; no orderly_poweroff, no backstop, IRQ stays disabled, OFF_TIME left at 20000. Only reachable on a GPIO get failure (not realistic for the SoC GPIO); a bounded retry would close it

checks.name: proposed_backstop_restart
checks.evidence: patches/0001 applied in powerfail_suo_proposed.c: after S+U the backstop checks the line and calls emergency_restart() when slider_off && slider_on; harness_proposed passes T25, leaves T26 unchanged and the other 24 scenarios unchanged (108 checks); partial fix only, not pushed to upstream

checks.name: overlay_property_rename
checks.evidence: dtc 1.8.1 rebuild of the head overlay: exit 0, no warnings, dtbo sha256 33309ef4e3278ac76b44cdc97c106f9b2b410ecbce0262689a3a2fae83a8779e; decompiled a3fd3e8 -> ff4cd84 diff is exactly m5stack,power-controller + m5stack,power-hold-ms (plus its local fixup); 5623292 -> ff4cd84 is exactly the property rename; evidence/overlay-compile.txt

checks.name: emergency_restart_exported
checks.evidence: rpi-6.12.y kernel/reboot.c: emergency_restart() sets system_state=SYSTEM_RESTART, takes no locks, is documented safe outside IRQ context and is EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL; declared in include/linux/reboot.h

checks.name: reference_register_semantics
checks.evidence: Open-IOE1 @4369350 README + firmware/main.c: 0xB6 0-4, state 2 max 100 ms, state 3 re-reads OFF_TIME live and clears READY, 0xB0 is host-writable, OFF_TIME min 200 applied per write (both bytes), boost is diode-OR of SW_EN and PB7; caveat: third-party reimplementation, not the stock binary

checks.name: hardware_validation
checks.evidence: no Cardputer Zero hardware; the author's 4.1 s/4.9 s shutdown, 15.7 s backstop and clean next boot are self-reported and were not reproduced

checks.name: virtual_device_validation
checks.evidence: cardputer-zero profile supported=false creatable=false backend_ready=false, missing __missing_qemu__/__missing_rom__; evidence/local-profile-summary.txt

checks.name: kernel_build_w1
checks.evidence: no kernel headers or cross toolchain; docker daemon unusable (read-only containerd state dir). The author reports W=1 clean, not re-run here

checks.name: timing_fidelity
checks.evidence: 1 jiffy = 1 ms; no I2C transfer latency, workqueue concurrency, or cancel_delayed_work_sync race; the M5IOE1 model quantizes its state machine to a 50 ms poll

checks.name: stock_dtbo_byte_identity
checks.evidence: the checked-in firmware/CardputerZero/overlays/cardputerzero-overlay.dtbo (sha256 e4425fee...) decompiles without a powerfail node, so it is an older build and the author's 'byte-identical to the installed stock dtbo' claim cannot be checked from the repository; only the source-level base->head diff was checked

evidence.description: 26 scenarios / 109 checks on the unchanged head source, all PASS
same harness with the backstop-restart proposal, 108 checks, all PASS
T7 (line high during the countdown + READY restore), T8 (slider high at .shutdown), T25/T26 (flip back during a hung poweroff, before and after the backstop)
0xB0/0xB2/0xB6 rows, the power state machine and the SW_EN/PB7 diode-OR from the Open-IOE1 reference at 4369350
head dtbo build/hash, powerfail node, local fixup and base->head semantic diff
emergency_restart() body and GPL export, declaration
redacted local Device Service cardputer-zero profile
PR state, head, scope and comment inventory at the second round

notes: Evidence class is host-level test plus code-level verification; no virtual-device or hardware run was possible on this host.
All four review points from the first round are fixed as described; the two requested scenarios pass with the expected timings.

Two non-blocking residuals: no restart point if a flip-back happens during a hung poweroff (T25/T26; the backstop sample only covers flips before hold-4 s), and an unbounded 100 ms recheck when the irq-gpios read fails (T19).
A partial proposal patch for the backstop restart is included and tested locally but was not pushed upstream.
No upstream branch was pushed, no PR was closed, and no other repository was modified; one English reply comment was posted.
